arxiv-2205-03206.title: Hybrid Beamforming Design for Millimeter Wave Multiuser MIMO Systems with Dynamic Subarrays
arxiv-2205-03206.creator: Gengshan Wang, Zhijia Yang, Tierui Gong
arxiv-2205-03206.description: Abstract In this letter, we investigate the millimeter wave (mmWave) downlink multiuser multiple-input multiple-output (MU-MIMO) system, adopting the dynamic subarray architecture at the base station and considering the multi-stream communication for each user. Aiming at maximizing the system spectral efficiency, we propose a novel hybrid beamforming design.

arxiv-2306-17098.title: A rare outburst from the stealthy BeXRB system Swift J0549.7-6812. 2021 A rare outburst from the stealthy BeXRB system Swift J0549.7-6812. – References
arxiv-2306-17098.creator: M. J. Coe, J. A. Kennea, I. M. Monageng, D.A.H. Buckley, A. Udalski & P. A. Evans
arxiv-2306-17098.description: Abstract Swift J0549.7-6812 is an Be/X-ray binary system (BeXRB) in the Large Magellanic Cloud (LMC) exhbiting a ∼ \sim 6s pulse period. Like many such systems the variable X-ray emission is believed to be driven by the underlying behaviour of the mass donor Be star.

arxiv-2412-06584.description: Abstract . We discuss convergence in the Fourier algebra A ⁡ ( G ) A(G) of a locally compact group G G and obtain a new characterization of local spectral sets of G G . 1. Introduction The notion of spectral synthesis was introduced by A.Beurling in the late 1930th.

arxiv-2412-08638.title: An Improved Precision Calculation of the 𝟎 ​ 𝝂 ​ 𝜷 ​ 𝜷 0\nu\beta\beta Contact Term within Chiral Effective Field Theory
arxiv-2412-08638.creator: Graham Van Goffrier
arxiv-2412-08638.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Graham Van Goffrier. Neutrinoless double-beta ( 0 ​ ν ​ β ​ β 0\nu\beta\beta ) decay is an as-yet unobserved nuclear process, which stands to provide crucial insights for model-building beyond the Standard Model of particle physics. Its detection would simultaneously confirm the hypothesis that neutrinos are Majorana fermions, thus violating lepton-number conservation, and provide the first measurement of the absolute neutrino mass scale.

arxiv-2412-11427.title: Towards Scientific Discovery with Generative AI: Progress, Opportunities, and Challenges
arxiv-2412-11427.creator: Chandan K Reddy, Parshin Shojaee
arxiv-2412-11427.description: Abstract Scientific discovery is a complex cognitive process that has driven human knowledge and technological progress for centuries. While artificial intelligence (AI) has made significant advances in automating aspects of scientific reasoning, simulation, and experimentation, we still lack integrated AI systems capable of performing autonomous long-term scientific research and discovery.

arxiv-2508-18367.title: The Impact of Radial Migration on Disk Galaxy SFHs: I. Biases in Spatially Resolved Estimates
arxiv-2508-18367.creator: I. Minchev, K. Attard, B. Ratcliffe, M. Martig, J. Walcher, S. Khoperskov, J.P. Bernaldez, L. Marques, K. Sysoliatina, C. Chiappini, M. Steinmetz, R. de Jong
arxiv-2508-18367.description: Abstract Knowledge of the spatially resolved star formation history (SFH) of disk galaxies provides crucial insight into disk assembly, quenching, and chemical evolution. However, most reconstructions, both for the Milky Way and for external galaxies, implicitly assume that stars formed at their present-day radii.

arxiv-2511-01613.title: Benchmark-Ready 3D Anatomical Shape Classification
arxiv-2511-01613.creator: Tomáš Krsička, Tibor Kubík
arxiv-2511-01613.description: Abstract Progress in anatomical 3D shape classification is limited by the complexity of mesh data and the lack of standardized benchmarks, highlighting the need for robust learning methods and reproducible evaluation. We introduce two key steps toward clinically and benchmark-ready anatomical shape classification via self-supervised graph autoencoding.

arxiv-2601-09402.title: Structured Knowledge Representation through Contextual Pages for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
arxiv-2601-09402.creator: Xinze Li, Zhenghao Liu, Haidong Xin, Yukun Yan, Shuo Wang, Zheni Zeng, Sen Mei, Ge Yu, Maosong Sun
arxiv-2601-09402.description: Abstract Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances Large Language Models (LLMs) by incorporating external knowledge. Recently, some works have incorporated iterative knowledge accumulation processes into RAG models to progressively accumulate and refine query-related knowledge, thereby constructing more comprehensive knowledge representations. However, these iterative processes often lack a coherent organizational structure, which limits the construction of more comprehensive and cohesive knowledge representations.

pmc-10617527.title: Risk Factor Analysis and Nomogram for Predicting In-Hospital Mortality in ICU Patients with Heat Stroke: A National Multicenter Study
pmc-10617527.creator: Lietao Wang, Xin Fu, Min He, Lvyuan Shi, Dingyuan Wan, Yucong Wang, Qin Wu, Jing Yang, Bayuan Cai, Hongtao Xia, Hongxu Chen, Ge Zhang, Xianying Lei, Wei Zhang, Zhongxue Feng, Bo Wang, Zhongwei Zhang, On behalf of Heat Stroke Research Group in Southwestern China
pmc-10617527.description: ObjectiveThe aim of this nationwide multicenter study was to ascertain the risk factors associated with in-hospital mortality in patients with heat stroke admitted to intensive care units (ICUs) and to develop a nomogram for prognostic prediction.MethodsA retrospective analysis was conducted on clinical data collected from ICU patients diagnosed with heat stroke across multiple centers nationwide.

pmc-11282861.title: Study on the consistency between CT hounsfield units and MRI evaluation of preoperative cervical paraspinal muscular fat infiltration in patients undergoing ACDF
pmc-11282861.creator: Yukun Ma, Dingyan Zhao, Xing Yu, Xinliang Yue, Letian Meng, Luchun Xu, Ziye Qiu, Ningning Feng, Guozheng Jiang
pmc-11282861.description: ObjectiveTo explore the feasibility of applying CT Hounsfield Units (HUs) for the assessment of preoperative paraspinal muscle fat infiltration (FI) in different segments in patients who underwent anterior cervical discectomy and fusion (ACDF). To compare the consistency of preoperative paraspinal muscle FI evaluations using MRI and those via CT HUs in patients who underwent ACDF surgery.

pmc-11337893.title: Evaluating the effectiveness of large language models in abstract screening: a comparative analysis
pmc-11337893.creator: Michael Li, Jianping Sun, Xianming Tan
pmc-11337893.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to evaluate the performance of large language models (LLMs) in the task of abstract screening in systematic review and meta-analysis studies, exploring their effectiveness, efficiency, and potential integration into existing human expert-based workflows.MethodsWe developed automation scripts in Python to interact with the APIs of several LLM tools, including ChatGPT v4.0, ChatGPT v3.

pmc-11442984.title: Non-canonical chromatin-based functions for the threonine metabolic pathway
pmc-11442984.creator: Jennifer K Chik, Xue Bessie Su, Stephen Klepin, Jessica Raygoza, Lorraine Pillus
pmc-11442984.description: The emerging class of multi-functional proteins known as moonlighters challenges the “one protein, one function” mentality by demonstrating crosstalk between biological pathways that were previously thought to be functionally discrete. Here, we present new links between amino acid metabolism and chromatin regulation, two biological pathways that are critical for cellular and organismal homeostasis.

pmc-11505146.title: Cell Cycle Complexity: Exploring the Structure of Persistent Subsystems in 414 Models
pmc-11505146.creator: Stephan Peter, Arun Josephraj, Bashar Ibrahim
pmc-11505146.description: Background: The regulation of cellular proliferation and genomic integrity is controlled by complex surveillance mechanisms known as cell cycle checkpoints. Disruptions in these checkpoints can lead to developmental defects and tumorigenesis. Methods: To better understand these mechanisms, computational modeling has been employed, resulting in a dataset of 414 mathematical models in the BioModels database.

pmc-11508620.title: Assessing the Potential of 1,2,3-Triazole-Dihydropyrimidinone Hybrids Against Cholinesterases: In Silico, In Vitro, and In Vivo Studies
pmc-11508620.creator: Carlos M Gastalho, Ana M Sena, Óscar López, José G Fernández-Bolaños, Alfonso T García-Sosa, Florbela Pereira, Célia M Antunes, Ana R Costa, Anthony J Burke, Elisabete P Carreiro, Alessandro Castorina
pmc-11508620.description: Combining the pharmacological properties of the 1,2,3-triazole and dihydropyrimidinone classes of compounds, two small families of mono- and di(1,2,3-triazole)-dihydropyrimidinone hybrids, A and B, were previously synthesized. The main objective of this work was to investigate the potential anti-Alzheimer effects of these hybrids.

pmc-11567106.title: Development and validation of an interpretable machine learning model for predicting the risk of distant metastasis in papillary thyroid cancer: a multicenter study
pmc-11567106.creator: Fei Hou, Yun Zhu, Hongbo Zhao, Haolin Cai, Yinghui Wang, Xiaoqi Peng, Lin Lu, Rongli He, Yan Hou, Zhenhui Li, Ting Chen
pmc-11567106.description: SummaryBackgroundThe survival rate of patients with distant metastasis (DM) of papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC) is significantly reduced. It is of great significance to find an effective method for early prediction of the risk of DM for formulating individualized diagnosis and treatment plans and improving prognosis.

pmc-11621642.title: Photodynamic Effects of Topical Photosensitizer, Photodithazine Using Micro-LED for Acne Bacteria Induced Inflammation
pmc-11621642.creator: Su Min Lee, Soo-Hyun Kim, Zun Kim, Jee-Bum Lee
pmc-11621642.description: BackgroundPhotodynamic therapy (PDT) using topical photosensitizers has been widely used worldwide as a therapeutic modality for acne. However, there are no published reports on photodithazine PDT for acne treatment.ObjectiveWe investigated the effectiveness of PDT with photodithazine and micro-LED treatment for acne bacteria-induced inflammation.MethodsWe established an acne bacteria-induced inflammation model by injecting of Cutibacterium acnes into the backs of HR-1 mice.

pmc-11677623.title: Is Whole-Body Cryostimulation Useful in Modulating Spasticity in Adults with Cerebral Palsy? A Case Study
pmc-11677623.creator: Paolo Piterà, Matteo Bigoni, Elisa Prina, Boris Barrera, Duru Ceren Yavuz, Federica Verme, Jacopo Maria Fontana, Lorenzo Priano, Alessandro Mauro, Paolo Capodaglio
pmc-11677623.description: Background: This case study investigates the effect of a five-session whole-body cryostimulation (WBC) cycle on a 55-year-old female patient with cerebral palsy (CP) and lower limb spasticity (LLS) with a typical diplegic gait pattern. CP is a common physical disability characterized by motor impairments, including spasticity, which significantly impacts mobility and quality of life.

pmc-12530026.title: A Thermoreversible Gelation Pathway to Mesoporous Aerogel Monoliths Based on Poly(methyl methacrylate) Stereocomplex Crystals
pmc-12530026.creator: Saadman Sakib Rahman, Anthony V Tuccitto, Zeineb Ben Rejeb, Patrick C Lee, Chul B Park
pmc-12530026.description: In pursuit of lightweight, functional thermoplastic materials, novel monolithic aerogels composed entirely of poly(methyl methacrylate) (PMMA) and its stereocomplex crystals are reported. Herein, PMMA aerogels are fabricated using a one‐pot thermoreversible gelation procedure, coupled with supercritical CO2 (scCO2) drying. These aerogels exhibit either mixed macro‐ and mesoporous, or exclusively mesoporous character, with low densities (0.03–0.

pmc-12563732.title: Tetraniliprole Triggers Transgenerational Hormesis in an Invasive Insect Herbivore: Molecular and Biological Insights
pmc-12563732.creator: Farman Ullah, Zeeshan Ullah, Ali Güncan, Guru-Pirasanna-Pandi Govindharaj, Hina Gul, Prabhu Prasanna Pradhan, Ghulam Murtaza, Xiaowei Li, Nicolas Desneux, Yaobin Lu
pmc-12563732.description: Simple SummaryThis study investigated the sublethal effects of tetraniliprole on the invasive tomato pest, Tuta absoluta. Although tetraniliprole caused high toxicity in third-instar larvae, sublethal (LC10) and low lethal (LC30) concentrations had complex effects across generations. The directly exposed generation (F0) experienced decreased development and reproduction.

pmc-12852825.title: Evaluating the effectiveness of green roofs and walls in Nigeria’s urban centers: a mixed-methods approach
pmc-12852825.creator: H C O Unegbu, D S Yawas, B Dan-asabe, A A Alabi
pmc-12852825.description: This study evaluated the effectiveness of green roofs and walls in Nigerian urban centers, focusing on their environmental, economic, and social benefits. Utilizing a mixed-method research approach, the research integrated quantitative surveys and qualitative interviews to provide a comprehensive analysis.

pmc-12885199.title: Identification of Candidate Inhibitors to SARS-CoV-2’s Enzymes and Potential Disruptors of Its Structural Proteins’ Interactions
pmc-12885199.creator: Ali Mohammadian, Mahdieh Jadaliha, Aylar Imanpour, Hamed Pourvali Moghadam, AmirHossein Jahangir
pmc-12885199.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background:Many studies have assessed the possible inhibitors for severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2). However, experiences like that from human immunodeficiency virus have taught us that a multidrug approach will reduce the chance of viral resistance.Materials and Methods:Here, we screened 2371 Food and Drug Administration-approved drugs for possible inhibition of nonstructural proteins of SARS-CoV-2 and expanded the work to include ligands that might interfere with the roles of structural proteins.

pmc-13173956.title: Pseudoaneurysm of the thoracoacromial artery associated with habitual shoulder dislocation: a case report
pmc-13173956.creator: Honoka Wada, Aya Hamasaki, Soichiro Okamoto, Shunki Yamamoto, Tsuyoshi Nojima, Tetsuya Yumoto, Atsunori Nakao
pmc-13173956.description: BackgroundShoulder dislocation is one of the most common joint dislocations encountered in emergency departments, but vascular complications are rare and often underrecognized. Pseudoaneurysms of the thoracoacromial artery, a branch of the axillary artery, are extremely uncommon and may present with subtle symptoms, delaying diagnosis.

pmc-13260650.title: Progress and prospects for herpesvirus vaccination using gB antigens
pmc-13260650.creator: Solomon English, Adam Khan-Qureshi, Alexander D. Douglas
pmc-13260650.description: The success of vaccines against varicella zoster virus (VZV) demonstrates the feasibility of high-level efficacy against clinical consequences of herpesvirus infection, but there is a need for new vaccines against others – in particular Epstein-Barr Virus (EBV), human cytomegalovirus (HCMV) and herpes simplex virus 1 and 2 (HSV). Herpesviruses use surface glycoproteins to trigger membrane fusion during cell invasion.

pmc-13591637.title: Self-single-atomization of active sites in electrochemical ammonia synthesis unveiled by machine learning potential
pmc-13591637.creator: Jun Long, Chenyu Yang, Huan Li, Hao Li, Jianping Xiao
pmc-13591637.description: Electrochemical nitric oxide (NO) reduction reaction (eNORR) has emerged as a promising route for the synthesis of green ammonia. Fe was observed experimentally with great activity and selectivity for eNORR to ammonia. However, we found that electrochemical performance over iron is not due to its intrinsic activity, but from an adaptive capability of self-single-atomization in operando conditions.
